summary: Diff implements backend change to make getCallerUserProfile return null for new users, updates frontend gating to route new authenticated users to ProfileSetup instead of SessionInvalidScreen, and adds sanitized console logging for signup/profile flow diagnostics.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend behavior change: saveCallerUserProfile now traps if the caller lacks #user permission and also traps when no existing profile exists ("Please complete sign up first."), which is not part of the requested gating fix and may alter profile-update semantics.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only specifies changing getCallerUserProfile() behavior for new users; it does not request tightening/altering saveCallerUserProfile authorization or adding a prerequisite that a profile must already exist.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend behavior change: signupWithRole explicitly removes authorization checks to allow any authenticated principal (including guests) to sign up.
hallucinated_features.reason: While possibly related to improving signup flow, the BuildRequest did not explicitly request changing authorization behavior of signupWithRole; it only required getCallerUserProfile not to trap and frontend routing changes.
